record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: run the integration checks through the real entry points, then every phase test file.

## Approach

Install the package into a temporary prefix and run `orchestra check --help` from an unrelated cwd. Install into a temporary HOME for Claude and OpenCode and load the generated skill directories. Run the installer matrix, copy-allowlist, agent-generation, and README checks. Record pass or fail per acceptance.

payload.title: Verify the portable core and harness installer
